title: CktHGVAE: A Symmetric Design/State Heterogeneous Graph Variational Autoencoder for Transistor-level Analog/Mixed-signal Circuit Design and Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.19508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose CktHGVAE, a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder for transistor-level analog/mixedsignal CMOS circuits that takes not only design variables but also state variables as its inputs and outputs. With a single hyperparameter configuration without topology-specific tuning, comparison between model-generated and SPICE-simulated circuit operational states gives median R2 values above 0.9 for typical single-ended voltage amplifiers and the CMOS inverter, and 0.81-0.96 for differential amplifiers with larger datasets. Latent-space optimization in the PCA-reduced latent space with Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, random search, and quasi-exhaustive search is demonstrated for a common-source voltage amplifier with NMOS input and resistive load, where the objective function is defined as a penalty for deviation from required circuit specifications. For each search strategy, 93.3 - 100% of all design candidates suggested

translated_title: CktHGVAE：一种用于晶体管级模拟/混合信号电路设计与分析的对称式设计/状态异构图变分自编码器
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CktHGVAE，这是一种面向晶体管级模拟/混合信号CMOS电路的异构图变分自编码器，它不仅将设计变量，还将状态变量同时作为输入和输出。在采用单一超参数配置、无需针对特定电路拓扑进行调整的情况下，模型生成的电路工作状态与SPICE仿真结果的对比显示：对于典型的单端电压放大器和CMOS反相器，中位R²值超过0.9；对于数据集更大的差分放大器，R²值介于0.81至0.96之间。我们以NMOS输入、电阻负载的共源电压放大器为例，在经PCA降维的潜在空间中演示了基于贝叶斯优化、进化搜索、随机搜索和准穷举搜索的潜在空间优化方法，其中目标函数被定义为对偏离所需电路规格的惩罚。对于每种搜索策略，在所有被推荐的设计候选方案中，93.3%至100%的方案……
tldr: 提出了一种同时以设计变量和状态变量为输入输出的异构图变分自编码器CktHGVAE，无需针对电路拓扑专门调参即可高精度预测晶体管级模拟/混合信号电路的工作状态，并能在潜在空间中实现电路规格驱动的自动化设计优化。
en_tdlr: CktHGVAE is a heterogeneous graph variational autoencoder that takes both design and state variables as inputs and outputs, enabling accurate prediction of transistor-level analog/mixed-signal circuit operating states without topology-specific tuning, as well as latent-space optimization driven by circuit specifications.
